articles.headline: iPhone Buyers Rush in Before Potential Apple Price Increases
articles.summary: Apple global iPhone shipments jumped 13% in Q2 2026, driven by strong iPhone 17 demand and stable pricing. Read the breakdown.

articles.headline: North Carolina Rep. Tim Moore Sold Up to $100K Worth of AT&T Stock
articles.summary: A August filing shows that Representative Tim Moore reported a sale in AT&T (NYSE:T), valued between $50,001 and $100,000. The transaction date is listed as August 14, 2026, with the report published on August 20,
